noticeMessages.free-capacity-low: Free allows 5 members, 2 teams, 250 active issues and new uploads up to 10 MB. Existing content is kept when above a limit. The shared monthly AI allowance is US$5; paid overage is unavailable.
noticeMessages.free-capacity-high: Existing members and files remain accessible. New members can join when fewer than 5 members are active. Free allows 2 teams, 250 active issues and new uploads up to 10 MB; existing content is kept when above a limit. Paid overage is unavailable.
noticeMessages.trial: Your trial ends at the time shown. Upgrade manually to keep paid features. You will not be charged automatically. The trial's US$5 AI pool does not refill; consumed and reserved usage count against Free allowance when it ends.
noticeMessages.payment-grace: Renewal payment failed. Payment grace ends at the time shown; cancellation or a provider restriction can end access sooner. Pay before then to keep paid features. Included AI and any previously authorized capped overage remain available during grace.
noticeMessages.cancellation: Cancellation is scheduled. Paid access ends at the time shown, or earlier if payment grace expires or a provider restriction takes effect. Your workspace then uses Free limits; existing members and files remain accessible.
noticeMessages.provider-pause: A provider pause is scheduled. Paid access ends at the time shown. Contact billing support to resolve it; existing members and files remain accessible under Free limits.
